transparency_note: This R6 design is frozen after R5 baseline results were observed, but before any R6 robustness outcomes are computed. It is therefore prospective relative to robustness outcomes, not a preregistration made before baseline estimation.

literature_rationale.use: Measurement decisions and their transparency affect construct validity; all R6 measurement choices must be explicit and auditable.

literature_rationale.reference: Steegen et al. (2016), Increasing Transparency Through a Multiverse Analysis
literature_rationale.use: Reasonable data-processing choices can alter conclusions; R6 tests a small, theory-relevant set of frozen alternatives rather than selecting favorable specifications.

literature_rationale.reference: Cameron & Miller (2015), A Practitioner's Guide to Cluster-Robust Inference
literature_rationale.use: Project-level clustering remains the core covariance target because repeated project-month errors can be correlated within project.

R6_1_minimum_usable_months.purpose: Test sensitivity to sparse availability of the closed-item resolution metric.

excluded_formal_threshold.reason: Model A has 465 projects, below the prospectively frozen N_min_projects=500. It may be shown only as a descriptive sensitivity diagnostic, not used as a formal robustness gate.

R6_1_minimum_usable_months.model_specification: Same dependent variables, regressors, project FE, calendar-month FE, and project-clustered covariance as R5; only the pre-frozen minimum usable-month requirement changes.

R6_2_common_support.purpose: Separate coefficient differences from model-specific sample-composition differences.
R6_2_common_support.rule: Require all five baseline analytic variables (ln_resolution, ln_open_age, asinh_backlog, ln_issues_new, ln_contributors) observed in a project-month, then retain projects with >=2 such months.
R6_2_common_support.action: Re-estimate Models A-D on exactly this same common-support project-month sample.

R6_3_auxiliary_signed_change_context.purpose: Test whether baseline associations are sensitive to observable code-size change context after the R4 source-semantics correction.
R6_3_auxiliary_signed_change_context.source_meaning: signed net code-size change = additions - deletions
R6_3_auxiliary_signed_change_context.sample_rule: Use each model's original R5 sample; no sample deletion based on net-code sign or magnitude.
R6_3_auxiliary_signed_change_context.model_change: Add asinh_net_code_lines as one auxiliary context covariate; all other specification elements unchanged.

R6_4_36m_window_extension.purpose: Test temporal-window stability using the robustness window already specified in R1E/R2.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.structural_frame_rule: Intersect the frozen R3 882-project frame with the pre-outcome R1D full_exposure_36==1 flag.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.data_rule: Rebuild only from the already frozen R4 raw OpenDigger snapshot; no new retrieval.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.semantic_rule: Use the corrected R4 variable meanings, transformations, sparse-zero rules, and missingness rules without modification.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.feasibility_gate: Run formal 36m regression only if exact reconstructed Model A has >=500 projects with >=2 usable months.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.if_gate_fails: Report 36m robustness as not estimable under the frozen design. Do not acquire new data or change indicators merely to rescue the robustness test.
R6_4_36m_window_extension.model_specification: Same corrected A-D fixed-effects models and project-clustered covariance as R5.

R6_MD1_resolution_observability.purpose: Characterize whether availability of the closed-issue resolution median is itself systematically related to observable project-month context.
R6_MD1_resolution_observability.outcome: resolution_observed_it = 1 when ln_resolution is defined within verified exposure, otherwise 0
R6_MD1_resolution_observability.estimator: project-FE + calendar-month-FE linear probability diagnostic with project-clustered SE
R6_MD1_resolution_observability.interpretation: Measurement-availability diagnostic only; no causal or performance claim.
R6_MD1_resolution_observability.reporting_rule: Report regardless of sign or significance; do not use it to redefine the R5 sample.

primary_evidence_dimensions: coefficient magnitude and its descriptive change across specifications
whether the bounded measurement interpretation changes
robustness_evaluation_rules.reason_no_hard_magnitude_threshold: No reviewed source supplies a universal coefficient-change cutoff for this measurement-oriented panel design.
robustness_evaluation_rules.failure_interpretation: Instability is evidence of a boundary condition, not a reason to change the sample, indicator, or model.

execution_policy.python: FREE-ONLY formal primary engine; freeze R6 outputs before Stata verification.
execution_policy.stata17: One consolidated local Stata 17 independent verification run after Python R6 outputs are frozen.
execution_policy.cross_software_rule: Diagnose discrepancies only; do not select the more favorable engine or alter model/data/sample.

explicitly_not_authorized_in_R6_core: alternative quantiles or means of issue_resolution_duration
winsorization chosen after seeing R5 results
two-way clustering or alternative covariance selected because it changes significance
new crawler or new data source
